name: browser-use
headline: Axiom: Code Skills for xOS Development
short_description: Axiom provides battle-tested Claude Code skills for xOS development. It supports Swift 6, SwiftUI, Liquid Glass, and Apple Intelligence. Ideal for operations teams building or maintaining iOS, iPadOS, watchOS, and tvOS applications.
author: CharlesWiltgen

sections.overview:
Axiom provides a specialized Claude Code skill for building and maintaining applications across Apple's xOS ecosystem. It includes battle-tested support for Swift 6, SwiftUI, Liquid Glass, and Apple Intelligence, enabling developers to leverage AI-assisted coding for iOS, iPadOS, watchOS, and tvOS projects. The skill is designed specifically for operations and development teams managing Apple platform applications, offering integrated tooling through multiple deployment options including Claude plugin, Codex port, and MCP bundle formats. With over 885 commits and active maintenance, Axiom delivers production-ready patterns and routing logic optimized for Apple development workflows.
Building iOS and iPadOS applications with Swift 6 and SwiftUI
Developing watchOS and tvOS applications with Apple Intelligence
Maintaining existing xOS codebases with AI-assisted refactoring
Implementing Liquid Glass design patterns in Apple apps
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/CharlesWiltgen/Axiom`
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
